limitations: Load records cover 0.2 seconds within approximately 6-second workloads, not continuous whole-workload acquisition
BLE advertising was observed over air; connected BLE traffic/throughput was not tested
NeoPixel transmission activity and controller reuse were tested, not forced controller-exhaustion or physical LED color/bit timing qualification
Selected transition captures do not prove universally glitch-free updates
Near-start stop/restart trials characterize near-worst phases, not a phase-exhaustive latency guarantee
GPIO marker includes Python marker/timer overhead; monotonic_ns is quantized and is not an independent calibrated clock
PM was disabled; native_sim, broader nRF configuration coverage, TOP=3 and full MISRA C:2025 evidence remain separate work
setup_failures_excluded: Initial VXI-11 waveform transfer failed; accepted captures used the raw SCPI socket
Loose CH2 connection invalidated early marker attempts; static high/low verified after user correction
Brief marker events were lost while scope status was Arm; accepted events waited for Ready before stimulus
USB file flush/cache and host BLE helper event-loop/scanning integration errors were corrected before accepted tests
